s.note: the crib room at the mine
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion and a grated carrot. Lay along the edge of 2 halved puff pastry sheets, roll up and seal. Brush with beaten egg, cut into pieces and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

s.note: Pilbara coast, barbie down by the water
s.how: Score 600g cleaned squid tubes and cut into pieces. Toss with oil, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli and salt. Grill on a very hot barbecue for 1 minute a side and finish with lime juice and coriander.

m.note: the whole town out for a barbie
m.how: Boil 1kg potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and 4 rump steaks over hot coals. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate until golden. Serve it all with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.

w.how: Bake a butter sponge in a square tin and cool overnight. Make up raspberry jelly and chill until just starting to set. Cut the sponge into cubes, dip each in the jelly and roll in desiccated coconut. Chill until firm and red and fluffy all over.

d.note: the mining town pub on a hot night
d.how: Juice 2 ruby grapefruits and stir with 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then mix with 400ml cold soda water. Chill well. Half fill 4 tall glasses or stubby holder cups with cold lager, top with the grapefruit soda and add a grapefruit wedge. Serve the grapefruit soda on its own for the drivers.
